name: Missle Game Ready 4K Pbr Textures Free
axis_orientation: Nose/Seeker is at the +1 end of the axis
operating_principle: The air-to-surface guided missile uses command or homing guidance to steer towards the target, with onboard sensors and computer adjusting its trajectory based on guidance signals.

components.description: The nose section contains the guidance system, which can use laser, infrared, or satellite signals to guide the missile.
This section contains the onboard computer and sensors that adjust the missile's trajectory based on guidance signals.
The warhead is the explosive component of the missile, designed to inflict damage on the target.
The rocket motor provides the propulsion for the missile, with some missiles using slower, longer-range jet engines or ramjets for increased range and speed.
This section contains the control surfaces and actuators that adjust the missile's trajectory based on guidance signals.
The tail fins and wings provide stability and control during flight, with some missiles using movable control surfaces for increased maneuverability.
The airframe casing provides the structural integrity of the missile, with the main body being the largest volume component.
